similarities.detail: Both plans introduce authenticate_user(...) -> User | None and use it from protected routes. /health stays public.

similarities.topic: Local user store, no cloud IdP
similarities.detail: Both verify credentials against src/users.py and sign with a local secret rather than an external identity service.
Both add POST /login and tests in tests/test_auth.py.

positions.a1: HttpOnly session cookie; authenticate_user reads the cookie. Mobile without cookies is out of scope (u1 must).
positions.a2: Authorization: Bearer JWT; POST /login returns JSON. Cookies cannot be required (u2 must).
Write header-based authenticate_user into the same file.
